CLASSÉ, c'est le même jeu que JOUER, avec les mêmes cartes et les mêmes règles. La seule différence : le résultat modifie ta cote (MMR).
- Une partie classée commence toujours sur Medieval Fortress, passe ensuite par Coliseum Ruins, Pirate Archipelago, Mystic Hollow, Nuclear Test Site ou Hanging Gardens, puis par Pyramid Necropolis, Synthcity ou Extraterrestrial Base, et se termine sur le Tesseract.
- Chaque partie classée reçoit un score. Les 100 premiers points : éliminations (30), rythme d'élimination (10), Difficulté finale (30), cartes atteintes (20) et temps de survie (10).
- Les grandes parties dépassent 100, jusqu'à 150 : les éliminations au-delà de 20 000 rapportent jusqu'à 20 points (tous à 300 000), et les minutes au-delà de 40 sur la dernière carte jusqu'à 30. Ces 30 points sont acquis à la 60e minute à +1500 % de Difficulté, à la 90e sans Difficulté, et seulement à moitié à faible Difficulté (la totalité dès +600 %).
- Une fois à 150, la partie ne peut plus rapporter de MMR : le jeu propose d'EXTRAIRE, ce qui termine la partie tout de suite et encaisse son gain, ou de CONTINUER. En coop, l'hôte décide pour l'équipe.
- Dépasse le score de référence de ton rang pour gagner du MMR ; reste en dessous et tu en perds. Plus ton rang est élevé, plus la référence est haute.
- Tout le monde commence en Argent II. Tes 5 premières parties sont des parties de placement et font évoluer ta cote 40 % plus vite, mais elles ne peuvent pas te faire monter au-delà d'Or I.
- Rangs : Bronze, Argent, Or, Platine, Diamant, Maître et Grand Maître. Chaque rang sauf Grand Maître a trois divisions (III, II, I) de 100 points.
- Un bouclier anti-relégation te protège une fois : la première défaite qui te ferait descendre d'un rang s'arrête à son plancher.
- Chaque fin de partie compte : mort, abandon, redémarrage ou fermeture du jeu. Mourir dans la première minute te fait perdre deux fois moins de MMR. En coop, l'hôte peut choisir CLASSÉ (2 joueurs minimum) : cela fait bouger un rang coop séparé, visible dans l'onglet CLASSÉ du tableau du salon.
# Classements
- MEILLEURS SCORES classe les parties par éliminations. CLASSÉ classe les joueurs par MMR. DUO, TRIO et QUATUOR classent les équipes en coop.
- Clique sur une ligne pour voir cette partie : armes, objets et meilleurs dégâts, ou le profil classé du joueur.
- Les scores ne sont envoyés que si Envoyer le score aux classements est activé. Masquer les classements retire le tableau du menu.
# Profil
Clique sur ta carte de joueur en haut à gauche du menu pour voir tes stats globales, tes personnages et armes préférés, et tes parties récentes. Clique sur une partie pour voir son récap.

guide.title: Coop
guide.text:
Joue jusqu'à 4 joueurs sur Steam.
# Se retrouver
- MULTIJOUEUR dans le menu principal ouvre directement un salon. Utilise INVITER UN AMI (c'est l'hôte qui invite), ou rejoins un salon public ou le matchmaking.
- Un salon peut être public ou réservé aux amis. Chacun appuie sur PRÊT, puis l'hôte appuie sur LANCER LA PARTIE.
- Tout le monde doit avoir la même version du jeu. Impossible de rejoindre une partie en cours.
# Ce qui est partagé
- Une seule horde pour tout le monde. Chaque joueur supplémentaire donne +50 % de PV aux monstres.
- L'XP et les niveaux sont partagés, mais chaque joueur choisit ses propres cartes.
- Les bonus de Difficulté et d'Apparition d'élites s'additionnent pour toute l'équipe.
# Ce qui est à toi
- Ton or, tes prix de coffres et ton butin. Les ressources vont à celui qui a fait l'élimination.
- Les marchands, autels et smoothies servent chaque joueur séparément ; ils partent une fois que tout le monde a été servi.
# Votes
- Les pactes de statue et les bénédictions sont choisis par un vote d'équipe chronométré.
- Le voyage exige que tous les joueurs soient prêts à la cabine téléphonique. Redémarrer se vote aussi.
# Mort
Un joueur tombé regarde les autres, puis revient à la cabine téléphonique avec la moitié de ses PV au bout de 10 à 30 secondes (plus longtemps quand la carte avance). Si toute l'équipe tombe, la partie est terminée.

guide.title: Astuces
guide.text:
# Tes premières parties
- Bouge sans arrêt. Rester immobile est le moyen le plus rapide de te faire encercler.
- Ramasse tout dès le début : l'XP et l'or font boule de neige, et les coffres coûtent plus cher à chaque achat.
- Fais les totems faciles et les autels de massacre tôt dans la carte ; leurs bonus durent toute la partie.
- Utilise les aimants quand le sol est couvert de cristaux, pas avant.
# Devenir plus fort
- Remplis tes 4 emplacements d'arme tôt, puis concentre tes améliorations.
- La Chance améliore tout : cartes, coffres, enclumes, largages et récompenses de totem.
- Les Dégâts contre élites et les armes à cible unique facilitent beaucoup les combats de boss.
- Ne néglige pas la défense : Armure, Esquive et PV te gardent en vie sur les cartes lointaines.
# L'éclipse
- Sois prêt avant 10:00 : le superboss arrive et les monstres se mettent à voler.
- À 11:00, tous les monstres ont le double de PV et de vitesse. Tue le superboss et file à la cabine téléphonique.
# Entre les parties
- Dépense tes ressources dans AMÉLIORATIONS après chaque partie.
- Essaie chaque personnage : leurs armes fétiches changent le déroulement d'une partie.
- Rejoins le Discord pour partager tes builds et signaler des bugs.

guide.title: Commandes
guide.text:
Voici les touches par défaut. Toutes peuvent être modifiées dans PARAMÈTRES > COMMANDES. Les touches du clavier suivent leur position physique : WASD devient donc ZQSD sur un clavier AZERTY.
# Clavier et souris
- [W] [A] [S] [D] ou les flèches : se déplacer. La souris oriente la caméra.
- [ESPACE] : sauter (la molette vers le haut marche aussi).
- [MAJ] + une direction : dash.
- [CTRL] : glisser au sol, piquer en l'air.
- [E] : interagir (coffres, totems, marchands, la cabine téléphonique...).
- [1] [2] [3] [4] : choisir une carte dans les fenêtres de montée de niveau, d'autel et de marchand.
- Maintiens [CLIC DROIT] : visée manuelle. Maintiens [CLIC GAUCHE] : mode de ciblage secondaire.
- Maintiens [TAB] : carte du monde et stats. [F] : ressources. [ÉCHAP] : pause.
- Maintiens [R] 2 secondes : redémarrage rapide (désactivable dans les paramètres).
- Maintiens [U] 2 secondes : se décoincer, te téléporte sur le sol dégagé le plus proche.
# Manette
- Stick gauche : se déplacer. Stick droit : caméra.
- [A] : sauter. [LB] : dash. [B] : glisser.
- Maintiens [LT] : visée manuelle. Maintiens [R3] : mode de ciblage secondaire.
- Maintiens [L3] 2 secondes : se décoincer.
- Dans les menus : la croix directionnelle déplace la sélection, [A] valide, [B] revient en arrière, le stick droit fait défiler les listes.
# Non assignées par défaut
Bannir la carte, Passer la montée de niveau, Relancer les cartes et quelques autres actions n'ont pas de touche au départ. Tu peux les assigner dans les paramètres ; les boutons à l'écran fonctionnent toujours.

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 13 → November 14)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 13 → November 14)

A new character, TV Head, a passive that grows through the run for every other character, choice cards that come first, unpicked level-ups that travel between maps, a Bowling Strike that is a pure roll, a gentler map 2 and a calmer late game, and a long list of fixes.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Choice cards come first.** When level-up cards (or the co-op blessing tray) are on screen, 1 / 2 / 3 pick the cards, even next to a merchant, a statue or an anvil. A reward that shows up while you choose (an altar reward, an armour swap) now waits in line instead of taking your key press, and a card that appears right after another menu ignores your keys for 0.45 s, so a press meant for one choice never lands on another.
- **Map 2 hits softer:** its monsters' touch damage is ×1.6 map 1's (was ×2.2).
- **Map 3 opens harder than the November 13 cut:** an 8-damage regular now hits 80 at 0:00 (×10 map 1).
- **Late-game monster damage grows calmer:** past 15:00 it keeps growing at the same pace as 10:00 → 15:00 until **20:00**, where it runs away (it used to run away at 15:00).
- **Spawn cone:** from 10:00, monsters can't spawn in a 90° cone ahead of your direction of travel (it was 50°).
- **Move speed is capped for passives:** Gumi's run streak and Auresaurus Jr.'s jump stack lift your speed up to a ceiling and no further. They never slow down a build that is already faster.
- **Booth:** opening the phone booth is now handled before any monster, hazard or shot, so you can no longer die on the very frame you press the button.
- **Targeting:** a badge under the hero, *Targeting: Elites & Bosses First*, shows for as long as you hold the secondary-targeting key, and disappears when you release it. The feed line is gone.
- **Mister Jackpot:** his face-down card no longer vanishes around level 500, when every weapon and armour is maxed.
- **Refrigerator** is now a free Legendary for every save, and it leaves the Coliseum branch of the upgrade tree.
- **Unpicked level-ups travel with you.** The level-ups you hadn't picked yet when you took the booth (the LIVE tray lets them pile up) used to be lost, while the level came along. They are now dealt again on the next map.
- **Chest bans have a floor:** banishing can never take out the last 2 items of a rarity. Stacked Ctrl+Z copies gave enough banishes to clear almost every tier. When BANISH is greyed with charges left, the chest now tells you why.
- **Totem and altar rewards no longer wait forever.** In solo, at a high level, a blessing could stay queued behind a level-up queue that never emptied. In co-op, a totem gave no reward until a level-up card showed up. A reward now queues in arrival order, and the cards that aren't dealt yet go behind it.
- **Stranded bosses are recalled:** a boss that moved less than 3 m and lost no HP for 8 s is put back on the spawn ring, so a golem stuck on Medieval Fortress can't make the eclipse unwinnable.
- **Pyramid Necropolis:** the mission shows on the board under MISSION, like on every other map, not under the minimap.
- **Coliseum Ruins:** a brazier only shows on the minimap and the big map once its cell has been explored.
- **Particle Opacity and Projectile Auto Opacity** now reach opaque weapon bodies (Circular Saw blade, Hot Potato, Bowling ball, Prospector bit, Asteroid Belt rocks, and about twenty others), which used to stay fully solid until the slider hit 0%.
- **Co-op unlocks:** a feat the team earns (a poison kill for Lillia, a superboss) now counts for the guest who did it, not only the host. Steam achievements reach Steam at once instead of the next day.

---

## 🧍 Characters

**New character: TV Head**, a monitor-headed drifter wrapped in cables. The CRT is heavy: +5% HP and fire rate, −5% move speed. He starts with the **Electrostatic Generator**, which any character can earn.
- **Glitch Cartridges:** coloured cartridges float at random spots of the map, 32 per map, like the resource nodes. Every weapon slot has a colour, and every 5 cartridges of a colour give that slot's weapon a level, exactly like an anvil would. A step earned while the slot is empty waits for the first weapon that fills it. Only TV Head sees and takes them.

**Character ornaments.** Agent Bald (CONTRACT KILLER: 100 marked targets killed in time in one run) and Frogita (GOURMET: 100 aged XP crystals caught by her tongue in one run) each get an ornament, and twenty more join them, one per body.

**Passives that scale through the run.** Every passive except Zeus, Nekage and Al Pachinko (the three that scaled without a cap) got a lever that keeps growing with your level or your run, and the base damage of every body is now at least ×1.00 (Mustafa was ×0.90, Plaguey, Zorp and Boingo ×0.95).
- **Agent Bald:** +0.5% crit per level. His distance bonus now ramps from ×1.0 within 1 m to ×1.35 from 5 m out, instead of switching on and off.
- **Frogita:** the Snag lash tears 1 more crystal per 15 levels and her damage per level is 25 (was 10). The Feast bonus is ×1.12 XP (was ×1.07).
- **Freaky Panda:** her grudge holds 4 s (was 2), and a new **Last Stand** leaves her on 1 HP instead of dying, once a minute.
- **Mustafa:** every chest he opens is +1% luck for the run, and every 10th chest he buys is free without moving the price curve.
- **Cluckson:** his sprint also cuts the damage he takes by 25% and heals 1%.
- **Cosmic Prince:** slowed monsters take +20% damage, +0.3% per level.
- **Verdicta:** her execution works on bosses below 5% HP, climbs with your level from 15% up to 35%, and one in four is a free bolt.
- **Kaiju-Kun:** he holds 3 plates +1 per 20 levels (up to 8), the plates refit faster with your level, and the shrapnel deals 20% of the monster's max HP.
- **Zorp:** the beam grows +2% per level, lasts 4 s and gives ×3 XP.
- **Tenzai:** the dash refund per kill is 25% (was 10%), and the cut hits 2% harder per level.
- **Mister Jackpot:** the face-down cards come one rarity higher, and every blind pick is +1% luck for the run.
- **Lillia:** 250 views per 1% (was 1,000), and the poison of a dying monster spreads to 2 neighbours.
- **Plaguey:** her Vitality procs need 4 targets and add damage for the run.
- **Dr. Singularity:** his singularity's final blast gets +50% of the damage it dealt, and spawns mini black holes (1, +1 per 25 levels).
- **Professor Mole:** a kill keeps the streak when the next target is within 5 m, and the drill tip gets +1% per stack (up to ×2).
- **Pink Zeppelin:** the riff plays every 2nd cast, at 60% plus 1% per level.
- **Cynja:** the recast has 50% plus 0.5% per level (up to 75%).
- **Boingo:** 25 damage per level, the chain adds +40% per bounce and the stomp radius grows 2% per level.
- **Auresaurus Jr.:** the meteor lands in 2.5 s (was 4), the chain is 12 tricks (was 20) and a pause on the ground costs 3 tricks. His jump stack tops out at 10 jumps (+50%).

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Global attack speed now feeds Orbit Speed and Minion Speed.** Solar System, Asteroid Belt, Goblin Catapult, Goblin Jockey and Hungry Mimic go faster with your attack speed. Your global projectile size also widens the planets and rocks of Solar System and Asteroid Belt.
- **Drill:** a kill keeps the whole streak when the next target is within 5 m, and the tip's splash grows 1% per streak hit, up to double.
- **Shuriken:** a caught star is thrown straight back out, free, with a 50% chance (+0.5% per level, up to 75%).
- **Bowling Strike:** the ball is a pure roll. It appears on the ground rolling down the densest lane of monsters, hits every monster it meets once and knocks it aside, and vanishes at the end with a crash. Knock over enough pins and a STRIKE! gives +50%. No slug flight, no gravity well and no crush any more.
- **Fallout:** the cloud grows as it lives (*Growing Threat*).
- **Void Tentacles:** nerfed. The flat damage of the slam counts ×6 (was ×15), and an extra rift now lands on its own pack for half the share.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **Phoenix:** the blast when you revive now hits every monster within 10 m exactly once (it used to cut off part of the crowd, and hit a monster twice if it had two colliders). It also has a visual now, an expanding ring sized to its reach.
- **Zombie Missile:** a missile's own kills no longer re-roll the item. In a dense late horde each missile bred more than one, and the chain wiped everything in range.
- **Spike Protein:** two late-game snowballs closed. The stack is priced from the smaller of the hit and your running weapon-hit average, and when another source already poisons the target, its stack joins at that poison's strength, never above it.
- **Necromancer's Punchcard:** the soul is now a violet will-o'-the-wisp flame (one quad per soul, instead of a skull and a ribbon).
- **Zombie Missile:** a kill made by a missile no longer launches another missile. In a dense late-game horde the missiles fed themselves in a chain that cleared everything around.

---

## 🗺️ Maps

- **Hanging Gardens:** a wind lift can no longer pin you under the rim cloud of the island above, where the camera zoomed into the cloud and hid your hero. The lift now eases off under a roof and pulls you toward its axis.
- **Synthcity:** the lucky cat landmark is solid, so you can't walk into its building any more.
- **Laser grid shrine:** the gaps in the walls are 20% bigger.
- **Pirate Archipelago:** the sea rocks are 30% fewer, blockier and set on a 2 m grid in quarter turns. The small reliefs glued to a big rock, which hindered wall-runs, are gone.
- **Coliseum Ruins:** the stone is repainted in the game's hand-made look (it was a noisy texture that didn't match).

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Co-op lobby:** worn ornaments and titles are bigger and readable, and the RUN plate under the status line is gone.
- **Item, armour and level-up popups** rise above tall bodies: Professor Mole's tank no longer swallows the picked-up item.
- **Kaiju-Kun's plate counter** resizes with his number of plates.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- **Verdicta's XP crystals** now count for the guest who picked them up, not only the host (the host used to book them all).
- **Lillia's Viral on a guest:** a monster that died poisoned on the host now counts as poisoned for the guest.
- **Name plates** fit tall bodies: Professor Mole's tank no longer hides the name inside it.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 13)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 13)

Bosses are now hit where you see them, maps 2 and 3 are much gentler, the eclipse curve is softer, and a handful of fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Boss hitboxes follow their mesh.** Weapons used to test a boss against a big vertical cylinder around its feet (a box seen from the side). They now test the boss's visible pose, so a Kraken, a pirate ship, a rainbow dragon or Olympus is hit where it is drawn. Contact damage and stop distances are unchanged.
- **Big bosses are no longer ignored by weapons.** Area and reach tests (zones, pulls, chains, items, perks and about a hundred weapons) measured the distance to a boss's *pivot*, so a 17 m boss like Olympus could take nothing from a weapon whose reach ended before that point. They now measure to its body.
- **Maps 2 and 3 hit softer:** all monster damage (touch, shots, boss specials) is divided by 2 on map 2 and by 3 on map 3. Map 4 onward is unchanged.
- **Map 2 and map 3 monsters have less HP:** the jump from map 1 to map 2 is now ×17 (was about ×24), and map 3 follows it down.
- **Eclipse curve softened:** from 10:00 to 15:00, monster HP grows by +100% per minute at most (it was +170% per minute). The 10:00 value, the ×2 at 11:00 and the end-of-the-world surge are unchanged.
- **END OF THE WORLD** starts at **15:00** (it was at 13:00).
- **Options:** *Unstuck* now sits in the main controls list, so a keyboard player can remap it (pressing a key while a controller capture was open used to be ignored).

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Fireball** leads fast bosses, so it no longer flies behind an Olympus running at 20 m/s, and a boss it hits takes the blast.
- **Hungry Mimic** and **Lasso** reach a boss's body, not the point deep inside it: the Lasso can target a big boss and the mimics bite it.
- **Shadow Trap** no longer instantly kills a boss. It deals its boss damage instead.
- **Goblin Catapult:** no more goblin standing over your head while you fire a burst. The shot is a ball from its first frame.
- **Playing Card:** the deck on the XP black hole no longer shakes when you move the camera. **Poker Hand** gets the same fix.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **Chests:** when every item at or below the rolled tier was banished, a chest used to give Stinky Sock, the first item of the catalogue. It now climbs to the next tier with something to drop.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 11 → November 12)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 11 → November 12)

Every weapon retuned, nine new 3D projectiles, a fix for items hitting twice, softer late-game monster scaling, new card layouts, and a lot of fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Late-game monsters hit and swell less:** past 10:00, the growth of monster HP and contact damage is cut in half. Past 15:00, the growth of contact damage is halved again.
- **Ranged attacks scale more gently across maps:** a monster's shot or thrown rock now grows with the square root of the map multiplier (×1 / ×2.1 / ×4.2 / ×8.5 on maps 1-4, was ×1 / ×4.4 / ×17.9 / ×71.7), so a single shot no longer kills a hero on map 3. Touch damage is unchanged.
- **Items no longer hit twice:** the damage of items sized as a share of a hit (Hot Take, Ignition, Pocket Black Hole, Zombie Missile, Hot Skull, Banana Phone, Spike Protein…) was multiplied a second time by your crit, armour and item bonuses, so items out-damaged weapons. Those hits now land already priced. Hot Take and Ignition also only read your latest *weapon* hit.
- **Defend totem:** landing on the totem while its trial runs stings you and throws you off, so you can't stand on top of the horde.
- **Anvil:** when the forge finishes, your weapon comes back to you on its own, with its boosts. Pressing E before the end still takes it back early.
- **Juggling shrine:** the ball bounces 20% faster and floats less.
- **Sphinx beam:** a beam now hits you once, and hits from several Sphinxes are spaced out (a player took 224 damage in a second).
- **Water:** wading in water slows your falls less (gravity 0.90, sink speed 5 m/s).
- **Minimap:** the orange and blue altitude outline is gone from every map. Cold Coliseum braziers show as small orange dots on the minimap and the big map.
- **Medieval Fortress:** hardened the wall-run so the same wall can't catch you over and over in a chain of rebounds.
- **Death screen:** a monster's shot still in the air after its shooter died now shows the monster that killed you, no longer "THE ENVIRONMENT".
- **[Full game] End of the world:** the Grim Reapers that rose from 13:00 are gone.
- **[Full game] Mystic Hollow and Hanging Gardens:** falling below the map no longer kills you. You reappear at the same spot at the very top of the map and fall back in.
- **[Full game] Synthcity:** fixed being stuck in the walls of the construction tower (its scaffold stair was too narrow for you), and a superboss that spawned sealed inside a building.
- **[Full game] Co-op chapters:** the host can start a chapter that any player in the lobby has unlocked.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **[Full game] Every weapon is retuned by category.** Each weapon is now balanced toward a late-game target by its category: Targeted, Chain and Piercing weapons are the earliest (200 M), Summon, Status and Crowd Control sit in the middle (300 M), Area, Ground and Aura come last (400 M). It was done with each weapon's own mechanics (sizes, passives, caps), not with a flat multiplier, and the per-weapon growth factors of November 9-10 are removed.
- **[Full game] Unused stats pay as damage:** weapons that can't use projectile count or attack speed (Aura, Pulse Aura, Radioactive Dust, Fallout, Combo Counter, Super Combo, Judgment Arrow, Sword of Damocles, Prospector, Asteroid Belt…) get them as damage instead. Only Pyromaniac keeps a Projectile Count card (it now throws one bottle per target).
- **[Full game] Nerfs:** Fallout (its ring now scales with the square root of the count), Chainsaw (3 grinds per window at level 50, was 5), Web Shot, Heads or Tails (it was dealing about 17 times a normal weapon).
- **[Full game] Donation:** the gold bonus now goes up to +300% (was +200%).
- **[Full game] Black Hole:** Projectile Speed now also makes the disc spin faster.
- **Level-based passives:** Whip gets extra echo cracks and a wider cone with size, Shotgun fires a heavier pellet from level 5, and 9mm and Akimbo ricochets hit harder with each bounce. **[Full game]** Drill drills extra targets, Claws rake round each slash, Goblin Catapult's goblins sweep their bat from level 12, Dragon Egg's whelps bite as a pack from level 15, Plague and Mushroom grow more virulent, Zeus Lightning overcharges its fan, and Solar System's rings reach further.
- **Shotgun, Whip, 9mm, Zeus Lightning, Goblin Catapult, Olympus Fist, Mushroom, Playing Card, Judgment Arrow:** retuned with the same pass, in their own way.
- **Tornado:** a monster rides a funnel for 1 s at most, and the lift follows crowd-control resistance, so a funnel no longer pins the whole horde.
- **Projectile Auto Opacity / Dynamic** now reaches the effects of Whip, Akimbo, Shuriken, Claws and the other weapons that ignored it.
- **[Full game] Hungry Mimic, Goblin Jockey, Adult Dragon and Pulse Aura:** retuned.
- **Playing Card:** its deck now docks on the XP black hole instead of floating over your head, and Poker Hand's cards do the same.
- **Lighter in the late game:** Claws, Black Hole, Tornado, Gravity Cannon and a dozen others cost less per frame with a full horde.

### New 3D projectiles

- **Playing Card** is a thick gilded blade spinning flat.
- **Judgment Arrow** is **the Eye of the Judge**: a knapped obsidian harpoon with violet veins and a living eye.
- **[Full game] Mjolnir** is a **storm-heart** hammer.
- **[Full game] Bowling Strike** is a retro strike ball.
- **[Full game] Gravity Cannon** fires a **graviton stake**, and plants a spike.
- **[Full game] Heads or Tails** throws a royal doubloon.
- **[Full game] Katana** cuts with a real 3D blade (Hanafubuki), as a rafale of cuts instead of one frame.
- **[Full game] Pyromaniac** throws a house cocktail bottle.
- **[Full game] Burning Forge** throws an overflowing crucible.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **[Full game] Pocket Black Hole:** 1% chance at one copy, tending toward 5% (was 2% toward 10%), and at most 5 holes at once (was 8).
- **[Full game] Curse:** every second (was 2 s) a random monster within 30 m (was 12 m) is cursed.
- Items you obtain, and armour you pick up, are now announced in the left feed with their icon and tier colour, no longer over your head.

---

## 🧍 Characters

- **[Full game] Gumi, run streak:** while he runs on the ground, his speed climbs by +4% per second, up to +60%. Any jump resets it.
- **[Full game] Auresaurus Jr., jump momentum:** every jump adds +5% move speed, with no cap, until a hit lands on him.
- **[Full game] Lillia:** the Viral counter goes past 999,999 (it showed "1.234M"), and so does its bonus.
- **[Full game] Zorp:** no more "ABDUCTION READY" label. His saucer's lights go out during the cooldown and flicker back on when he's ready.
- **[Full game] Loot Smoothie machine:** a new **juice bar** frame (awning, candy posts, wooden sign).

---

## 🗺️ Maps

- **Coliseum Ruins:** the cosmic chest's reveal now shows a violet starry chest, no longer a plain brown one. The braziers to light show on the maps as orange dots.
- **Side missions:** on Coliseum Ruins, Mystic Hollow, Nuclear Test Site and Hanging Gardens, a mission that isn't needed to finish the map no longer blinks red.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Level-up cards:** a new **title band** layout, with the key, the name, and the rarity and NEW / level chips on a band above the card, and a lighter icon vitrine.
- **Armour slots:** the higher the rank of a piece, the livelier the animated background behind its slot.
- **Passive icons:** the 52 forge passives have new 64 px icons.
- **UNLOCKS → WEAPONS:** the category plate touches its tile, with bolder text.
- **Co-op lobby:** the buttons are regrouped into two black docks (the run on the left, the session on the right), and its boards take the leaderboard's lifebar look, with whole player names.
- **Co-op blessing tray:** ALT + click works like on the level-up tray.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 10 → November 11)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 10 → November 11)

Solo PAUSE / LIVE level-ups, a KILLED BY card on the death screen, full profiles in the leaderboard, weapon categories, a big pass on item chances, a Steam Deck legibility pass, and a lot of fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Level-up mode in solo:** CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER now has a **LEVEL-UP** strip above WEAPONS PER RUN. Pick **PAUSE** (the game stops, you choose) or **LIVE** (three cards at the bottom, no pause). PLAY and RANKED share the choice, and it applies from the next map.
- **Phone booth arrival:** you can no longer walk, jump or dash while the booth is still falling from the sky.
- **First map:** bosses that arrive before 10:00 have +25% HP.
- **Pyramid Necropolis:** fixed deaths with nothing visible on screen. The Sphinx's orbital beam now lands on the floor you stand on, inside the room with you, and a monster can no longer bite you through a floor, a wall or a roof.
- **Defend totem:** fixed the totem still pulling the horde after it was done, which left no spawns near you until the next map.
- **Juggling shrine:** the ball can no longer bounce on top of its own totem.
- **Coliseum Ruins:** a violet chevron on the minimap and the big map points at the standing superboss.
- **[Full game] Lich King:** his light balls only hit when they actually touch you (the hit sphere was 3.6 m, now about 1.2 m).
- **[Full game] Scorpius:** it can no longer erupt on top of another boss.
- **[Full game] Auresaurus Jr.'s ride:** fixed the model jumping a few metres off the wall during a side wall-run.
- **Options:** the *Wall-Run From the Ground* row has a clearer label and hint.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **UNLOCKS → WEAPONS:** every weapon now shows its **category**, with a colour code, on its tile and its detail card: Crowd Control, Targeted, Piercing, Chain, Area, Ground, Aura, Status or Summon.
- **[Full game] Strong buff, ×2 late-game growth:** Aura, Pulse Aura, Fallout, Radioactive Dust, Burning Forge, Chainsaw, Drill, Fireball, Gravity Cannon, Meteor, Pyromaniac, Snowball, Solar System, Asteroid Belt, Vinyl, Adult Dragon, Bouncing Comet, Prospector and Spirit Spear.
- **[Full game] Vinyl:** flies 16 m (was 12), and one record can land at most 30 hits over its whole out-and-back trip, so it no longer sweeps the horde twice.
- **[Full game] Tornado:** a monster now rides a funnel for at most 1 s before it is flung out, and no funnel can lift it again for 2.5 s (it still takes damage inside one). Elites are never lifted, only pulled and hit. The lift now follows the monsters' crowd-control resistance like every other effect: shorter from 7:00, none at 20:00.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **Ignition:** its burn and its corpse blast are 6% of the hit that lit the monster (was 10%).
- **[Full game] Shockwave:** a new look, a rush of chevrons sweeping out of the hit, and a new chance curve: 3% at one copy, tending toward 20%.
- **[Full game] Zombie Missile:** each missile deals about 15% of your average weapon hit (was 100%), and the first copy's kill chance is 15% (was 20%).
- **[Full game] Bowling Ball:** 2% of the launching hit at one copy, tending toward 20% (was 10% up to 80%).
- **[Full game] Ice Cube Tray:** the shards deal 4% of the killing blow at one copy, tending toward 20% (was 25% up to 75%).
- **[Full game] Smite:** 5% chance at one copy, tending toward 25%.
- **[Full game] BOGO Soul:** +6% bonus-crystal chance per copy, at most 20%.
- **[Full game] Spike Protein:** at most 10 of its stacks on one monster.
- **[Full game] Phoenix:** every copy you obtain in a run halves its drop chance, even after a revive spent one, and chests, merchants and pods offer at most one per map.
- **[Full game] Pocket Lint:** it is Uncommon now, and its cap is back to +200% per stat per copy (the November 9 cut to +50% is undone).
- **[Full game] Boss-kill item:** it grants +5% of a random stat per copy for every boss killed (was +10%).

---

## 🧍 Characters

- **[Full game] Lillia:** her Viral bonus has no cap any more, in return for slower growth: +1% damage against poisoned monsters per 1,000 views (was per 100, up to +40%).
- **Agent Bald:** fixed his left arm hanging away from his body. His left shoulder was 3.5 cm too far out in the original skeleton.
- **[Full game] Pink Zeppelin and Lillia:** fixed dark patches (the guitar, her left arm) where two parts of the body painted over each other's shading.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Death screen:** a **KILLED BY** card slams in above the title in the VS look, with the name of what killed you and how much it dealt over the last second.
- **Leaderboard:** in a player's recap, **PROFILE** opens their full profile, with their ornament round the picture. Players on an older build show Steam stats only.
- **Main menu:** the PATCH NOTES ticket blinks until you open a new patch, and the UPGRADE TREE button's gold is easier to see.
- **Steam Deck:** bigger text in the patch notes, credits, wiki, feedback, UNLOCKS tabs, upgrade tree, chapter select, survival guide and character select. Prompts follow the device you use, so a controller shows A / ✕ rather than "CLICK", and only one pad is read at a time.
- **Smaller download:** monster and hero textures now ship at the size the game displays.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- **Player colours:** each player has their own colour (gold, cyan, violet, coral). It tints their arrow on the minimap and the big map, their name plate and their partner card.
- **Team feats:** a feat achieved by the team (such as clearing a boss wave) now unlocks the character for every player, not only the host.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 9)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 9)

Diagonal dashes, a new look for the leaderboard, the chapter window and the weapon variants, a big pass on weapons, a settings clean-up, and co-op spawns that no longer pile up on your partner.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Diagonal dashes:** hold Shift with a side key and W or S to dash at 45° (forward-left, back-right…). Side, back and diagonal dashes now carry your whole speed in the new direction instead of just cancelling it.
- **Contact knockback halved:** a monster's touch pushes you half as far (4.5 m/s, was 9).
- **Crowd-control resistance** now starts at 7:00 and reaches 100% at 20:00 on every map (it used to start at 10:00 and end at 30:00).
- **Dive Slam** deals less: 4 damage per level (was 20), so 400 at player level 100 before the fall bonus.
- **Phone booth:** on every map that has one, the booth now falls from the sky and slams down when you arrive, including on the first map of a run.
- **First map:** regular monsters have 30% less HP (was 35%), bosses are at 90% of their HP (was 75%), and the superboss is tougher (+10%).
- **[Full game] Spikes:** touching a spike clump now hurts once and throws you back out. It only re-arms after you leave the zone.
- **[Full game] Monsters that leap between storeys** fly 20% slower along the same arc, so they spend more time in the air.
- **[Full game] Sandbox:** the mode is switched off and not part of this build.
- **[Full game] Boss wave goal:** wiping out a wave of five bosses now counts when the superboss is one of the five, and when a newer wave arrives before the first is finished (a player met the condition and got nothing).
- **Memory:** fixed several leaks that piled up from one map to the next (prop materials, icons, music tracks and cached assets), so long sessions use less memory.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Shotgun** and **[Full game] Future Shotgun:** the Projectile Count card replaces Projectile Speed. Each point adds a pellet, up to +10 (20 in total), then the extra points become blast damage.
- **Whip:** longer reach, 10 m (was 7).
- **Playing Card** no longer has the impact zone introduced on November 8. **[Full game] Donation** keeps it, and its **Attack Speed** card is gone.
- **[Full game] Pulse Aura:** 1.1 s between pulses (was 0.8), and a new **Pulse Speed** card shortens it. **Fallout** gets the same card.
- **[Full game] Aura, Pulse Aura and Fallout** now hit a **sphere**, not a flat cylinder: monsters above or below you are no longer missed, on planets too.
- **[Full game] Dice Roll** and **D20:** a new **Roll Luck** card makes the roll lean toward the best face (6 or 20).
- **[Full game] Vinyl** flies 12 m.
- **[Full game] Lasso:** up to 10 lassos at once (was 3). A monster it swings no longer collides with you and launches you into the air (seen on Coliseum Ruins with the crocodile).
- **[Full game] Prospector:** 6 m of reach (was 4).
- **[Full game] Tornado** lasts 2.4 s (was 3).
- **[Full game] Katana:** the sakura slash no longer stops growing with your size stats (it was capped at ×3).
- **[Full game] Hungry Mimic:** the chests now fly on every map and ignore gravity. Their Minion Speed also sets how fast they bite.
- **[Full game] Akimbo:** it no longer gets the 9mm's boosted fifth bullet.
- **[Full game] UNLOCKS tree:** Judgment Arrow and Mjolnir swapped places.
- **[Full game] Late-game scaling:** every weapon's per-level growth is 15% higher, but it now takes until weapon level 30 (was 15) to reach full strength. Void Tentacles and Chain Reaction now take part in it too.
- **[Full game] Black Hole:** the pull reaches 4 m (was 5), the well lasts 2 s (was 2.5) and ticks 4 times a second (was 5).
- **[Full game] Gravity Cannon:** the anti-gravity zone is 3 m wide (was 2).
- **[Full game] Snowball:** every ball bursts at a flat 17 m, and the Range stat no longer stretches the flight.
- **[Full game] Fireball** gains +1% Ignition chance every 3 weapon levels (3 levels = 2%, 6 = 3%…), and **Pyromaniac** gets the same passive. Its Projectile Speed card now shortens the bottle's flight, so the fire lights sooner.
- **[Full game] Arrow Rain:** each tick that lands has a 10% chance to add a bleed stack.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **UNLOCKS:** you now have to keep at least **10 Legendary items** switched on (12 Rare, 4 Extreme, 7 for the others).
- **[Full game] Pocket Lint:** at most **+50%** per stat per copy (was +200%).
- **[Full game] Pocket Black Hole:** 2% chance at one copy, and more copies tend toward 10%. Its hole is 5 m wide again, and damages every 0.5 s (was 0.25).
- **[Full game] Ignition:** the chance can't go past 10%, however many copies you have (was 25%).
- **[Full game] Holy Nova:** 3 m radius at one copy, tending toward 8 m with more copies.
- **[Full game] Hot Take:** its fires now have their own line in the recap, and no longer take the name of whatever weapon fired last.
- **[Full game] Supernova** (Astronomy): it deals 7.5% of the dead monster's max HP (was 40%), and the blast that can hit you has half the radius.

---

## 🧍 Characters

- **[Full game] Boingo:** the stomp's damage is now a sphere as big as the ring you see, so a monster on a crate or a ledge is no longer missed.
- **CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER:** when you start the run, your hero now leaves the pad and dives straight into the black hole. **RANDOM** shows a dark 3D question mark on the pad. The hero no longer ends up standing inside a prop of the planet (a pyramid step, a wall).

---

## 🗺️ Maps

**[Full game] Nuclear Test Site**
- The silo fans lift 50% faster and harder, spin faster and are about 30% wider, and their air column goes twice as high.
- The minimap and the big map show the silo as a **3D slice**.
- The phone booth now always starts at the **top of the silo**, at a random spot along the rim.

**[Full game] Maps made of planets:** altars, anti-gravity devices, resource nodes and shrines can no longer be placed inside a prop's corner (the old check only used a sphere around the prop's centre).

**[Full game] Pirate Archipelago:** fixed a totem standing inside the volcano.

**[Full game] Synthcity:** the airdrop's ground mark was hidden under the road. A new track, **Speed of Light**, joins the map's music.

**Main menu music:** it always opens on **Space Explorer**, then shuffles only its own tracks.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Leaderboard** is rebuilt in the fighting-game **lifebar** look: each score is a health bar, with a chamfered portrait, a rank badge, a crown on #1 and a green 1P bar for you. The run time sits left of the score, the tabs have icons, and the board is taller with bigger names.
- **[Full game] CHOOSE A CHAPTER** has a new **slash split** look: leaning columns split by white-hot seams, giant numerals and a gold title band.
- **[Full game] Weapon variants window:** now a **face-off**. The two cards lean toward each other on a split screen, with a VS crashing down between them, and the window opens with an animation.
- **CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER:** the portraits take up more room, the panel is plain navy, and the astronomy picks are now one bare row of tiles at the bottom of the screen.
- **Upgrade tree:** your board is now saved on your profile. It used to be dealt again at every launch, so any patch that added or re-tiered an item moved nodes to other branches and made your progress look lost. Your bought nodes now keep their place, and new content is added at the end of its branch.
- **Wishlist buttons** are gone from the main menu and the death screen.
- **Weapon icons** in the HUD are 10% bigger.
- **Run recap:** the **Nuke** has its own line.

---

## ⚙️ Options

- **Removed** Motion Blur and Shadow Quality / Shadow Detail: they never changed anything.
- **Hide Leaderboards** now applies at once, including to the podium flyby and the co-op lobby boards.
- **Grass** Low / Medium now thins the grass right away, not from the next map.
- **Debug RAM** works with Debug FPS off. Both FPS rows stay in sync.
- **Camera Shake Off** now also holds the menu cameras. Settings are saved when you close the panel.
- **Look smoothing** now defaults to 100%.
- A new option makes **auto-pick** also take Extreme or rarer cards.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- **Spawns:** monsters can't spawn within **20 m** of any player. A spawn that would land inside the circle is redirected outside it, never deleted, so waves keep their pace and monsters meant for one player stop appearing on the other.
- **Recap:** the damage of your partner's weapons no longer shows up as yours, including fire, poison and plague.
- **Level-up tray (pad):** a held LT (also Aim) no longer blocks D-pad picks after a skip or refresh, nor on merchant, altar, anvil, statue or smoothie panels.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 8)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 8)

A new character, Lillia, replaces the Doctor. CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER is rebuilt and flies you to a planet, the Hanging Gardens are rebuilt as sky islands, utility weapons get a damage cut, and co-op spawns are fixed for good.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## 🧍 Characters

- **[Full game] New character: Lillia**, the influencer. She **replaces the Doctor** and starts with **Coronabirus**. Her passive, **Viral**: every monster that dies poisoned earns views on the screen on her back. Every 100 views, her hits and poison ticks deal +1% more to poisoned monsters, up to +40%. She is a little quicker and luckier than average (+5% move speed, +10% Luck), and a little more fragile (−5% HP). Her shoulder bag swings like a lantern, no longer clips through her forearm, and her twin tails sway as she runs. Whoever had the Doctor unlocked has Lillia.
- **[Full game] Kaiju-Kun** has a reworked pilot who sits properly in the cockpit, with a new colour palette and a clean face. A new **armour-plate counter** next to him shows how many plates he has (such as 2/3), the plate being fitted, and a flash when one breaks.
- **[Full game] Professor Mole** is alive in his hatch: he glances around, sniffs, peers at the drill, bobbles when running, leans into turns and nods on landing.
- **[Full game] Cosmic Prince:** no more T-pose in the middle of a jump.
- **Al Pachinko:** his nose is no longer flat, and his trousers no longer stretch forward at the knee.
- **[Full game] Pink Zeppelin:** her portrait now looks straight at you, not from above.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **[Full game] Utility weapons nerfed:** **Black Hole** deals 40% less damage and **Tornado** 50% less. Their job is crowd control, the damage comes second.
- **[Full game] Tornado:** the funnels are now born 5 m in front of you, in the direction you aim, instead of on top of you. A multi-shot fans them out 30° apart.
- **Playing Card** and **[Full game] Donation** now have an **impact zone**: every other monster close to the one that was struck takes the full hit too. The zone is 1.5 m wide and grows with your projectile size. Donation's gold bonus now goes up to +200% (was +100%).
- **Judgment Arrow** and **[Full game] Sword of Damocles:** the wait between two arrows shrinks by 10% every 5 levels, down to nothing at level 50, and attack speed speeds it up further.
- **Goblin Catapult:** the goblin ball now lands where the monster is when it's thrown, not where it stood. A close target is no longer overshot.
- **Goblin Catapult** and **[Full game] Goblin Jockey:** the Attack Speed card is gone. **Minion Speed** now also sets how fast the goblins strike, and it keeps growing in the late game like the damage does.
- **[Full game] Wheel of Fortune** can now roll an **Attack Speed** card: +8% spin speed on a Common one.
- **[Full game] Late-game balance pass:** a weapon-by-weapon check against Akimbo. Stronger in the late game: Aura, Donation, Drill, Katana, Heads or Tails, Akimbo, Judgment Arrow, Sword of Damocles, Zeus Lightning, 9mm, Burning Forge, Mysterious Trap, Electrostatic Generator, Bowling Strike, Prospector, Goblin Jockey, Asteroid Belt, Pulse Aura and Bouncing Comet. Slightly weaker: Dice Roll, Gravity Orb, Firecracker, Pyromaniac, Void Rain, D20, Hot Potato, Hungry Mimic and Zeus Cloud.
- **[Full game] Arrow Rain:** each projectile now makes its own rain zone, instead of making one zone hit harder.
- **[Full game] Adult Dragon:** each projectile hatches one more dragon, up to 10 at once (was 4).
- **[Full game] Vinyl** now throws a 3D record, a violet "neon bass" disc with glowing grooves.
- **[Full game] Claws** no longer offer an Attack Speed card.
- **[Full game] Fallout:** its cloud comes back after you park the weapon on an anvil and take it back.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Co-op spawns:** the protective cone around your partner is gone. It was refusing so many of your spawns that waves came in way too slow for the Difficulty. Only the safety radius around your partner remains, at most 20 m.
- **Coliseum Ruins:** completing the 70 braziers mission now rewards you with a **cosmic chest** (an item of Legendary or better), as lighting the rocket does on Nuclear Test Site.
- **Superbosses** are now shown with a **violet skull** on the minimap and the big map, the colour of their HP bar. Other bosses stay red.
- **[Full game] End of the world:** the Grim Reapers that rise from 13:00 now walk at half a regular boss's speed. A frozen reaper (during the Phoenix's time stop) no longer kills on contact, and a Reaper's touch can't burn several Phoenix revives in a single contact.
- **Anvils:** in co-op, an anvil no longer vanishes when you press E right after quick-parking a weapon on it. Taking a weapon back before it was forged at all no longer uses up the anvil.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **UNLOCKS:** you now have to keep at least **12 Rare items** switched on (7 for the other rarities). Rare is the biggest tier.

---

## 🗺️ Maps

**[Full game] Hanging Gardens: rebuilt as sky islands**
- The clouds are no longer a random maze with jagged heights. The map is now **8-9 organic islands** spread over **6 storeys**, from 30 m up to 180 m, separated by one-cell void channels and two lagoons.
- Islands are linked by **bridges, stairs and wind lifts**, and the relief inside each island has gentle variations.
- Each island has its own **garden theme**: mushrooms, candy, ruins or orchard. There are fewer cherry trees.

**[Full game] Pirate Archipelago:** fixed the phone booth sometimes starting in the volcano, with you on its cone.

**Music:** on a map with its own tracks, they now all play first, then the shared playlist, then it starts over.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER** is rebuilt: a grid of portraits with names on the left, the chosen character's sheet on the right (weapon, passive, base-stat bars like in UNLOCKS). When you open it, the menu camera leaves the black hole and flies to a **random planet** where your character stands in idle on a hologram pad. Drag to turn them around. Locked characters can be looked at (as a silhouette), but not picked.
- A **WEAPONS PER RUN** strip (1 to 4) sits above START RUN, and an **ASTRONOMY** strip lets you choose the astronomies of your run, right on this screen.
- The frame is more lively: a marquee header with chasing bulbs, light chasers round the panels, cards that lift and shine on hover, sparks when the cursor lands, and a "n / 22" collection gauge.
- The frame now has a slanted **VERSUS** look, and **START RUN** stays lit with a sweep of light so it's easier to spot. Character names always fit on one line, as big as they can be, and the astronomy photos are bigger, with what each does shown in a card above the tile you hover.
- **Run recap:** outright kills (Spirit Spear, Implosion, Mysterious Trap, Void Tentacles…) now have their own **Executions** line instead of being credited to the weapon, so weapons that hit again and again are no longer drowned out.
- **Credits:** Aure's and Vivi's names now shine in moving colour too.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 6 → November 8)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 6 → November 8)

A juicier upgrade tree, new animations for Edge of the Mirror and Doomsday Yapper, a big pass on weapon speed and damage, a reworked Snowball, an erupting volcano and bouncy lily pads, Grim Reapers at the end of the world, and a lot of spawn and co-op fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **[Full game] Stronger weapons:** Combo Counter, Shuriken, Black Hole, Gravity Cannon, Playing Card, Wheel of Fortune, Drill, Mjolnir and Coronabirus got more damage per level.
- **[Full game] Hot Potato:** +33% damage and +10% explosion radius, since its damage lands seconds late.
- **[Full game] Fireball:** each hit has a 1% chance to set the monster on fire, like the Ignition item.
- **[Full game] Implosion and Chain Reaction:** the first implosion now kills outright only 1% of the time (a failed roll takes the first shock directly, like it does on a boss).
- **[Full game] Nekage's SCRATCHES** only counts Blood Crescent hits now, not the Claws.
- **[Full game] Faster weapons:** about 35 weapons and 20 variants now attack more often, with the damage of each hit unchanged (so their damage per second goes up). Among them: Tornado every 1.5 s (was 5.5), Shuriken 1.0 s (was 2.2), Chainsaw 1.3 s (was 2.6), Mushroom 1.5 s (was 2.2), Void Rain 1.4 s (was 4.0), Gravity Cannon and Goblin Catapult 1.5 s (were 2.86), Playing Card 1.0 s (was 1.4), Combo Counter 1.2 s, Dice Roll 1.0 s, Katana 0.9 s, and Aura now ticks every 0.1 s. Their variants follow. **Donation** is the exception: it is slower, 1.1 s (was 0.85).
- **[Full game] More damage per hit:** Dice Roll 8 (was 3), Meteor 14 (was 8), Spiritual Spear 10 (was 6), Goblin Catapult 6 (was 3), Snowball 5 (was 3), Drill 3 (was 2), Void Rain 3 (was 2), Radioactive Dust 2 (was 1), Pyromaniac 3. **Firecracker** now deals 7 to 15, growing with the length of its fuse (was 5 to 11). Variants too: Goblin Jockey 10, Void Tentacles 10, D20 9, Super Combo beam 10, Adult Dragon bites 4, Fallout 2, Prospector 2 per bite, Hungry Mimic 4 per bite, and each Asteroid Belt rock 6 (was 3).
- **[Full game] Snowball reworked:** the ball now flies dead straight, with no lob and no gravity, and grows the farther it travels. Its range is 25 m, scaled by your range stat.
- **[Full game] Tornado:** the funnels now always drift away from you and never toward you.
- **[Full game] Claws:** the weapon's damage growth now levels off at ×3.
- **[Full game] Bouncing Comet:** much stronger in the late game: its damage and crit cards grow more than twice as much per level.
- **[Full game] Fewer wasted shots:** Snowball, Donation, Firecracker and Dragon Egg no longer send every projectile at a monster that is already as good as dead. They spread out over other targets, and slow projectiles keep their reservation until they land.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **[Full game] Edge of the Mirror** has a new look: an oval silver mirror with a reflected double of your hero running inside. When you hit something, the double jabs out of the glass. At the end of the wall-run, the mirror cracks and shatters.
- **[Full game] Doomsday Yapper** has a new look too: a big red megaphone that winds up, spins 360° and sends out shouting rings. Monsters get stunned when the rings reach them, with stars over their heads. The more copies, the closer its cooldown gets to 2 s.
- **[Full game] Answered Prayers** is reworked: it is now **Extreme**, and at the start of every new map all your other items are rerolled into new ones, using your current Luck.
- **Ghost Pepper:** +5% move speed per enemy within 10 m at one copy (up to +100%). Each extra copy adds less: 8% per enemy and +150% at two copies, never past 20% per enemy and +300%.
- **Pocket Lint:** at most **+200%** per stat per copy (was +500%).
- **[Full game] Soul Sommelier:** the ×1.20 XP now applies to crystals left on the ground for **45 s** (was 60 s).
- **[Full game] Hot Skull:** the share of the killing blow is 20% at one copy and tends to 80% with more.
- **[Full game] Zombie Missile** and **Spike Protein:** their chance tends toward 50% as you stack copies, and never goes past it.
- **[Full game] Smite:** the chained bolts deal 20% of the triggering hit. **Holy Nova:** the whole radius curve is 30% smaller. **Refrigerator:** the slow is 25% (was 45%).
- **[Full game] Slot Machine** spins once every 20 s (was every second).
- **[Full game] Guardian Angel:** at most 3 copies drop in a run.
- Items that cap out now say it in their description ("at most 8 black holes at once", and so on).
- Fixed armour going below zero after you blend a Mood Ring in the Smoothie Machine. Removing Mood Rings now takes their roll off right away.
- **Co-op:** the items your partner's chests give you can now be banished too, and the banish window is back in co-op chests.

---

## 🧑 Characters

- **Zorp:** ABDUCTION now lets you steer at full run speed while the saucer hovers, and the cooldown shrinks by 1% per level.
- **[Full game] Boingo:** fixed landings that didn't stomp, and the stomp rings now lie flat on the ground you landed on.
- **[Full game] UNHINGED:** the damage from missing HP now holds for a few seconds after you take a hit, so lifesteal can't erase it instantly in the late game.
- **UNLOCKS → CHARACTER:** a new card shows each character's **signature weapon**.
- **[Full game] Auresaurus Jr.'s egg** is much bigger (4 m), so it's easier to spot.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **[Full game] End of the world:** from 13:00, a Grim Reaper now rises once a minute.
- **Fixed monsters appearing right on top of you** when you stand on a roof or a high platform (seen on Medieval Fortress): monsters that climb up from a roof edge now start at least 15 m away.
- **Co-op:** spawns were far too slow when your partner walked toward you, because their "no spawn in my path" zone refused your own spawns from far away. See the November 8 notes for the final fix.

---

## 🗺️ Maps

**[Full game] Pirate Archipelago**
- The **volcano** erupts with a new ash surge made of toon puffs and cinders, and a roaring furnace sound for the whole eruption. The lava rocks on the stone pillars are now only decoration and no longer burn you.
- **Lily pads** squash when you bounce on them and splash the sea with foam rings.
- Fixed the gable textures on three pirate houses.

**[Full game] Nuclear Test Site**
- Fixed wall screens drawn on top of each other on the silo walls.
- The props on the platforms (tanks, generators, crates, containers, booths) have new hand-painted textures instead of stretched tiles.

**[Full game]** The Grim Reaper's reward chest is more spectacular, with a constellation of lights and a bright flare.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Upgrade tree:** much juicier, and still readable. Motion means state: owned nodes glow and pulse with the core, nodes you can afford breathe with a green halo and a ▼ marker, and everything else stays still. The tree opens with a light front from the core, buying a node sends out rays and sparks, and a refused purchase shakes. Map names have a new pixel look, and a starfield drifts behind.
- **New keybinds:** **Choose Mystery Card** (for Mister Jackpot's face-down card, shared with Choose Card 4 by default) and **Camera closer / farther** in game, without opening the options.
- **Leaderboard recap** shows the **Astronomy** modifiers a run was played with.
- **Main menu:** the black hole has no particles or ring in the horizontal plane any more, so the logo reads better. The floating podium looks much nicer, stays in the world once it has appeared, and its light beam is fainter. The co-op lobby now plays the menu's playlist.
- **Credits:** Gumi's name now shines in moving colour.
- **Co-op lobby:** worn titles show in the lobby and above players' names in game, and wide ornament frames no longer stretch or get cut.
- A capped item can no longer be handed out as a second copy by a chest, a merchant or a partner's chest.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- Fixed long co-op games where enemies stopped spawning after about 14 minutes, and games where one player saw no monsters at all while the other had them all piled on them (found on Nuclear Test Site). A guest's monsters could die only on their own screen.
- Free chests from elite kills are rolled by the host again, so the guest no longer gets extra chests nobody else can see.
- Fixed a long-lived boss vanishing or reappearing for the guest in long games.
- Guests now wait for two updates from the host before removing a monster that seems to be missing, to stop monsters from blinking in and out.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 5 → November 6)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 5 → November 6)

A new playable character, a 3D logo on the main-menu black hole, a big weapon tuning pass, an earlier end of the world, and fixes for co-op spawns.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## 🦖 [Full game] New character: Auresaurus Jr.

- A T-rex kid in a propeller cap and pixel shades, riding a BMX. Quick on two wheels and a little lucky (HP ×1.00, speed ×1.15, luck +0.05). His starting weapon is **Meteor**.
- **Passive, EXTINCTION:** chain tricks (ground jump, air jump, wall-run start, wall jump, vault) and on the **20th** a giant meteor falls on you for a nuke. The chain breaks after 1 s on the ground, and the same trick twice in a row doesn't count. A small counter next to your character shows the chain.
- He has his own animations for pedalling, hopping, 360 spins, the "Superman" off a wall, crouching in a slide, and riding along walls with his tyres on the surface. His dash has its own tucked-in pose.
- To unlock him, find his hidden **fossil egg** and press **E** on it.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay & balance

- **The END OF THE WORLD now starts at 13:00** (was 20:00): the banner, the darkening and the harsh monster scaling (HP, damage and speed) all kick in earlier.
- **Spawn rate is no longer capped.** The +1000% cap from the last patch is gone: more Difficulty means more monsters again. **Block Party** now stops dropping at around +4200% Difficulty.
- Monsters at the start of maps 3 and 4 are tougher: their opening HP is ×25 and ×20 that of the previous map's opening (was ×20 and ×17.5).
- **Co-op:** monsters no longer spawn in your partner's path. The spawn rules (the cone ahead of a moving player, and the safe radius) now protect every player, not just the one the spawn was drawn for.
- **Flat damage cards** now show the same rarity values for every weapon (+2 for Common, +3 for Uncommon…). The real gain still depends on the weapon.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Flat damage per level:** Whip −20%, 9mm −25%, Web Shot −20%. Playing Card +10%, Shuriken +25%, Fireball +40%, Meteor +40%, Arrow Rain +20%, Burning Forge +15%.
- **[Full game] Fallout:** poison stacks up to **50** (was 10), and it uses Radioactive Dust's growth.
- **[Full game] Zeus Cloud** is much stronger and its bonus cap goes 5 → 10. **Sword of Damocles** waits 1.2 s between arrows (was 1.79 s) and grows like Judgment Arrow. **Lasso** grows like it did before the Whip's nerfs. **Super Combo** hits harder: 0.7× per tick (was 0.3×) and the giant tick 3×.
- **[Full game] Bouncing Comet:** impacts deal 45% (was 35%), and with no monster ahead it now hits the one under it instead of bouncing on empty ground.
- **[Full game] Void Rain:** the combo now decays smoothly every second instead of resetting after 4 s without a hit.
- **[Full game] Bowling Strike:** each extra projectile now throws one more ball, at another target, like the Gravity Cannon and the Electrostatic Generator. **Lasso:** each extra projectile adds one more crash's worth of damage.
- **[Full game] Guided Missile** no longer chases a dead monster until it runs out of time.
- **[Full game] Hungry Mimic:** new 3D model with proper wooden planks, a lid, fangs and a tongue, plus a new icon. **D20** has a new icon.
- **Projectile Auto Opacity** now dims by **24 points every 10 weapon levels** (76% at level 10, 52% at 20, 28% at 30, 4% at 40), and it now affects the explosions and effects that kept full opacity before.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **[Full game] Pocket Lint** no longer raises Power-up chance.
- **Glitched Cartridge:** the level-up cards now show a clear **x2** plate when the card applies twice.
- Chest openings only show items that can really drop: a banished (or still locked) item no longer flies out of every later chest.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **The GO NEXT! logo is now 3D**, wrapped on the main-menu black hole. Two logos turn slowly around it, one passing the lens about every 21 s. The black hole stands upright in the menu.
- **A second menu theme:** Space Explorer now plays alongside the regular one.
- The UI hover sound is a new, softer double beep.
- Fixed transparent gaps in the ornament frames on the wide co-op lobby plates.

---

## 🔧 Fixes

**[Full game] Hanging Gardens**
- Objectives, chests, anvils and Void Cube cubes no longer end up inside the giant pillars. Points of interest already inside one are moved out.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 5)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 5)

Ornaments and titles, a Friends leaderboard, 1 to 4 weapon slots, a rebalance of ranked placements, more orbiting and hunting weapons, projectiles that leave from in front of you, and a lot of fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## 🏅 Ornaments & titles

- New **ORNAMENTS** tab in UNLOCKS. **10 very hard challenges** each unlock a **title** and an **ornament**: a showy animated frame that replaces your level frame. Some examples: clear a chapter's last boss without taking a single hit, kill 100,000 monsters in one run, survive 90 minutes, or reach account level 100.
- Your worn title shows in green over your profile card. Your ornament shows on the profile and in the co-op lobby, where the plates widen to fit it.
- Earning one plays a celebration toast, like unlocking a character.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Projectiles now leave from slightly in front of your character** instead of from the middle of the body. This goes for dice, cards, the 9mm, Hot Potato, the saw, the Mushroom and more. The 9mm tracer now comes out of the gun instead of trailing behind you.
- **Orbiting weapons wrap around you in the air:** on the ground, Solar System planets and Asteroid Belt rocks keep their ring around you. While you're airborne, they spread into a **sphere** that protects you from every angle. Their size also grows with your Orbit Speed.
- **[Full game] Asteroid Belt:** twice as many rocks, on more rings, with the outer band turning the other way. **Solar System** has more rings.
- **[Full game] Drill:** reach 4 m → 6 m and a wider tip (0.9 m → 1.3 m). **Every extra projectile makes it grind one more enemy at once.**
- **[Full game] Arrow Rain:** 15 hits per salvo instead of 10, in the same 1 s.
- **[Full game] Chain Reaction (Implosion variant):** Projectile Count now starts more first implosions per trigger.
- **[Full game] Hungry Mimic** now hunts: with nothing in reach, the chest hops toward the nearest monster (within 10 m). On maps where monsters fly, it flies after them. **Goblin Jockey** also flies on those maps.
- **[Full game] Fireball:** the spinning crescent around the ball is gone.
- **Projectile Auto Opacity** is on by default. Its dimming now comes in steps of −20% every 12 weapon levels (80% at level 12, down to 20% at level 48), and it also covers weapons whose effects dimmed themselves before.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **[Full game] Magnetism:** every pulse also pulls the free chests dropped by elites and bosses toward you. The pulse is every 60 s (was 30 s).
- **[Full game] Wanderer's Boots:** each copy now counts the distance you walked since **its own pickup** (+200% after 2 km per copy).

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay & balance

- **Spawn rate** now scales with Difficulty up to about **+1000%** (it used to level off around +330%). **Block Party** keeps dropping until then.
- The darkening at **20:00** is lighter: the map keeps about 64% of its light (was about 37%).
- **[Full game]** About **20 weapons and items** that used to be unlocked from the start now have to be earned in the UNLOCKS tree, like in the demo. What you already own is kept.

---

## 🧑 Characters

- **[Full game] Plaguey:** fixed a hole in his elbow.
- Fixed a character portrait that could show as a white T-pose on the very first frames of the menu.

---

## 🏆 Ranked

- **Placement games** move your rating **40% more** than normal games (was twice as much), and they can't take you above **Gold I**. Losses count normally, and from Gold I upwards you climb with your normal games.
- **Dying in the first minute** of a ranked run now costs **half** the rating. Quitting still costs the full amount.
- The Ranked wiki page is updated in every language.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Leaderboard:** new **FRIENDS** tab with the Steam friends who play, ranked among themselves.
- **Leaderboard recap:** a new **PROFILE** button shows another player's profile stats (runs, total kills, best kills, deepest map, time played).
- **Weapon slots:** on UNLOCKS → WEAPONS, you now choose to play with **1 to 4 weapons**. The weapon HUD only shows the slots you picked.
- **Auto Select After Level** goes up to level 600. **Auto Select the Rarest Card** now stops and shows you the normal reveal when an **Extreme-or-better** card is on the table.
- **Run Recap:** character perks, Dive Slam, thorns, bleed and the other non-item sources now have their own icons instead of the poison flask.
- **Minimap:** the above/below outline is gone on Medieval Fortress, Coliseum Ruins, Pyramid Necropolis, Pirate Archipelago and Synthcity (the big map keeps it).
- Enlarging the minimap no longer makes it overlap the resource feed, and boss health bars no longer sit across the kill and chest counters.
- **Credits:** 17 more playtesters. The window shrinks to fit small screens.
- The main-menu podium no longer shows a top player as "[unknown]" while Steam is still loading their name.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- Items that trigger on hit or kill (Ice Cube Tray, Ignition…) now work for guests like they do solo, and their damage shows in the guest's recap.
- Fixed the co-op lobby being too dark.

---

## 🔧 Fixes

**All maps**
- Points of interest no longer stand on top of each other: a magnet on an anvil on Mystic Hollow, or resource nodes inside a totem or a chest.
- Fixed jump height draining to 0 with Mood Ring, armour and the forge, the same way move speed used to.

**Coliseum Ruins**
- The "light every brazier" mission now needs **70 of the 100 braziers** (the extra 30 stay lightable for luck).

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (November 3 → November 4)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (November 3 → November 4)

A late-game weapon balance pass, livelier monster physics, rejoining in co-op, a few item and character changes, and fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **Late-game balance pass:** every weapon and variant that fell behind got stronger damage, Crit Chance and Crit Damage on its level-up cards, so at max level they now all deal about as much as the best ones. Nothing was nerfed.
- **Weapon knockback is back to full strength:** the Whip, for example, pushes monsters about 2.25 m again.
- **[Full game] Mjolnir** can roll **Projectile Count**: extra hammers circle around you, like the Shuriken's stars.
- **[Full game] Shuriken:** no more execute. Its bleed is capped at 5 stacks.
- **[Full game] Tornado:** when it fades, it flings monsters up into the air.
- **[Full game] Electrostatic Generator** damage now has its own line in the run recap.

---

## 🧑 Characters

- **Frogita:** damage ×0.90 → ×1.10.
- **[Full game] Professor Mole:** his Drill reaches 1% farther per character level (4 m at level 1, 6 m at level 51).

---

## 🎒 Items

- Item tooltips (TAB) have a new **Currently:** line that shows what the item really gives you right now (for example Exo Mech's exact flat damage).
- **[Full game] Plot Armor** now doubles your Armor stat, instead of capping each hit at 99% of your HP.
- **[Full game] Exo Mech:** +1 flat damage per 200 max HP (was per 50).

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay

- **Monster physics:** monsters launched into the air keep their momentum and fall back down with real gravity, and hordes piling up against a wall now spill over the top.
- **Evasion** can now go up to 99.99%.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- Item icon outlines now match their rarity again (some kept their old colour after a rarity change).
- Renamed options: **Auto Select the Rarest Card**, **Incoming Attack Color** and **Projectile Auto Opacity**. The **RAGE** power-up on the ground is now called **BERSERK**.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- **Rejoin:** if you lose the connection to the host mid-run, a **CONNECTION LOST** window lets you **REJOIN** the same run with your character, or go back to the main menu.

---

## 🔧 Fixes

- **Coliseum Ruins:** 4 braziers could spawn inside closed rooms, so the "light every brazier" mission couldn't be finished.
- **[Full game] Nuclear Test Site:** bosses no longer all spawn at the very top of the silo: they now land on your floor.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (October 26 → November 2)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (October 26 → November 2)

Account levels and frames, two new Extraterrestrial Base bosses, Endless and Ranked in co-op, character buffs, a new Ranked score, a big weapon and item balance pass and a long list of fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo. The demo now has Medieval Fortress and Coliseum Ruins.

---

## 🏅 Account level

- Your profile now has an **account level from 1 to 100**. Every run earns account XP: for playing, for every minute survived, for kills, objectives, chests, elites, bosses and superbosses, and for every map you travel to.
- **10 pixel-art level frames**, one every 10 levels: Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Jade, Frost, Royal, Infernal, Celestial and Cosmic. The last three are animated.
- Your frame sits around your avatar on the main menu, with an XP gauge that fills up when you come back from a run. The death screen shows the account XP you just earned, and the co-op lobby shows every player's frame and level.

---

## 👾 [Full game] New Extraterrestrial Base bosses

- **The Cosmic Brain:** a floating alien brain with two bulging green eyes and 8 tentacles. Every 7 seconds it throws 3 big asteroids, the first one at you. A shadow shows where each one lands.
- **The Hungry Moon:** a horned black moon wearing the eclipse's demon face. It slams into your planet and sends a ring of fire from pole to pole. Jump over it!
- They replace the old boss rotation on this map. **King** and **Celestial Knight** are gone from the game.

---

## 🧩 Missions & trials

- **[Full game] New trial: Laser Grid.** On chapter 2 (Pirate Archipelago, Mystic Hollow, Synthcity) it replaces the Gambit. 10 laser walls sweep toward you, one every 1.8 s, all coming from the direction you face when you activate it: cross each one through a square gap. The lasers don't hurt. **Totem Fast Pass** and **Demolisher** don't speed the walls up: each copy removes one wall instead (5 minimum).
- **[Full game]** On Extraterrestrial Base the trial is now always the **Expanding Zone**: the floating cubes could drift off a planet into space.
- **[Full game] Void Cube trial:** the cubes now spawn at random all around the totem, from 10 m below it to 20 m above, instead of in one flat layer.
- **Chase totem:** a retro arrow over the spirit now shows where it will jump next.

---

## 🗺️ Maps

**All maps**
- Minimap and big-map markers get an **azure outline when they are above you** and an **orange one when below**, so you know whether to climb or drop.

**[Full game] Mystic Hollow**
- **Spore geysers:** up to 10 puffball columns lift you up through the forest.
- The minimap and the big map now draw the real treetops instead of a flat green square. The trees the Heartwood targets show in red.

**[Full game] Extraterrestrial Base**
- **All 18 planets are now different**: the 9 second copies got their own looks (Winter, Crimson, Fallout, Obsidian, Ice, Emerald, Red Sands, Amber and Sunset).
- The eclipse no longer plays on this map.

**[Full game] Nuclear Test Site**
- The silo is 24 m shorter, now 11 storeys.
- The minimap and the big map only show your part of the silo (3 levels) and hide the markers of the other levels.

**[Full game] Pirate Archipelago**
- The cliffs, sea stacks and sea arches were remodelled without overhangs, so you can wall-run on them.

---

## 🗡️ Weapons

- **[Full game] Vinyl replaces Explosive Taunt** (Pink Zeppelin's starting weapon): a record thrown like a boomerang, piercing everything, double damage on the way back. Your unlock carries over.
- **[Full game] Donation** now lobs one tumbling **gold bar** per shot that ricochets off its target, instead of a stream of coins. Same damage per second, new icon.
- **Shotgun:** +2 flat damage on its level-up cards at every rarity.
- **9mm:** −10% flat damage per level.
- **Dragon Egg** ×2.2 and **Heads or Tails** ×1.5 flat damage per level.
- **[Full game]** Weapons that were far behind got big buffs to their flat damage per level:
  - **×3+:** Implosion, Gravity Cannon, Plague, Guided Missile, Solar System, Water Drop, Burning Forge, Claws, Donation.
  - **Smaller boosts:** Katana ×2.5, Chainsaw ×1.7, Combo Counter ×1.7, Mjolnir ×1.6, Black Hole ×1.4, Radioactive Dust ×1.4, Snowball ×1.3.
- **[Full game]** Burning Forge and Solar System can roll **Crit Chance** and **Crit Damage**. Forge puddles hit twice as hard. Claws, Katana and Donation cards are 50% stronger. Claws can roll Attack Speed, Donation can roll Projectile Count.
- **[Full game] Aura and Pulse Aura:** their % damage now grows with your flat damage cards on regular monsters.
- **[Full game]** Toned down: Arrow Rain, Spirit Spear's execute (a flat 1%), Water Drop bubbles (10 bursts instead of an execute). Vinyl and Blood Crescent now have a cap on enemies hit per pass.
- **[Full game] Variants:** Circular Saw, Poker Hand, Goblin Jockey, Divine Claw, Bouncing Comet and Future Shotgun buffed. Adult Dragon, Hot Potato, Asteroid Belt and Zeus Cloud toned down. Fallout's poison is capped at 10 stacks. Hungry Mimic also bites up to 10 nearby enemies.
- **[Full game]** Weapon variants now show their own name everywhere: forge cards, run recap, tooltips, leaderboard.

---

## 🧑 Characters

- **Frogita:** her tongue's hitbox is 3× wider (0.3 m → 1 m), HP ×0.80 → ×1.00, and her weapons can reach **level 55** instead of 50.
- **Al Pachinko (Double or Nothing):** every tails now makes chests cost 16% more **for the rest of the run**, and it stacks. It used to apply to the next chest only.
- **[Full game] Boingo (Boing Boing):** stomp damage 6 → 9 per level, 0.25 s of invulnerability on each stomp, and the stomp radius grows by 1% per player level. Landing without holding Jump only loses 2 links of the chain instead of all of it.
- **[Full game] Professor Mole (Continuous Drilling):** the drill stays hot after a kill (the streak is halved instead of reset), and the streak bonus now hits every enemy at the drill tip.

---

## 🎒 Items

- **Caffeinated Cat** no longer fights: it flies around collecting the resources closest to you, with a little rainbow trail.
- **Banana Phone** 3% (was 1%). **Evade Window** +20% Evasion and up to 1 s of dash invulnerability. **Hex Shades** marks a nearby enemy: your first hit on it deals +200% and poisons. **Clanker Detector** makes every projectile weapon able to home. **Porcupine Panic** spikes scale with your weapons. **Ctrl+Z** gives +1 refresh, banish and skip on every map. **Pocket Lint** can raise any stat, up to +500% per stat per copy.
- Fixed **Cargo Shorts** and **Mood Ring** draining a fast player's move speed down to 0.
- Items with a copy limit now say it in their description ("Unique: one per run." or "Max N copies per run.").
- The stacked-copies line in item tooltips now shows the real values for about 55 items (some effects shrink or level off with copies instead of adding up).
- **[Full game]** About 20 weak items reworked so they keep up late in a run, including **Resting Bitch Face, Hand Warmer, Tax Return, Soul Sommelier, Ignition, Turret, Skeleton Key, Self-Reflection, Static Sweater, Reaper's Punch Card** (now works with every weapon), **Group Chat** (7%, +5% per extra copy, up to 20%), **Mom's Spaghetti, Hot Skull** and **Double It and Give It to the Next** (now passes poison and burn on).
- **[Full game] Turret:** new model with a turning head and recoiling barrels. Each extra copy gives +100% damage and −1 s cooldown.
- **[Full game]** Stronger high tiers: **Sick Combo** (+30% per move, up to +180%), **Terms and Conditions** (+800% damage), **Slot Machine, Smite, Lava Lamp, Ratio'd, Blood Moon** and **Skill Issue** (30%).
- **[Full game]** Runaway items reined in:
  - **Gambling:** chances capped at 50%, at most 10 copies. 20 copies used to make every hit deal 0.
  - **Necromancer's Punchcard:** Extreme, one per run.
  - **Holy Nova:** moved to Cosmic.
  - **Gluttony:** moved to Legendary, +6% per item.
  - **Bootleg Excalibur:** every 400 kills.
  - **Pocket Black Hole:** never above 20% chance, at most 8 at once.
