- **[Full game]** Cosmic and higher items are now about **10× rarer** in chests, and much rarer at merchants and in the vault.
- **[Full game] New rarities:** **BOGO Soul**, **Tax Return** and **Rented Wings** are now Rare. **Discovery** is now Rare and limited to 1 copy (its +25% XP no longer stacks). **Rage** is now Uncommon. **Answered Prayers** is now Cosmic. **Double It and Give It to the Next** is now Cosmic, max 5 copies.
- **[Full game] Hot Skull:** 5% chance (was 20%).
- **[Full game] Soul Sommelier:** XP crystals left on the ground for over a minute give ×1.20 XP. Each extra copy adds a bit less (+5% for the 2nd), up to ×1.50.
- **[Full game] Pity Timer:** 10 level-ups without a Divine card guarantee one, and 50 without a Darkness card guarantee a Darkness (was Legendary and Cosmic).
- In **UNLOCKS**, you now have to keep at least **7 items per rarity** switched on (was 5).
- **[Full game] Full Metal Jacket:** copies now stack, +1% attack speed per copy on each proc.
- **[Full game] Block Party** stops dropping once your Difficulty already maxes out the end-of-map spawn rate (around +330%).
- **[Full game] Smoothie Machine:** blending two Cosmic items now gives an Extreme one, and every blend goes one tier up, all the way to the top tier.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay & balance

- **Elites** now really have 3× the HP of a normal monster all run long. Past about 3:00 they used to drop back to normal HP.
- **After 20:00 on a map, monsters scale much harder:** their HP and contact damage double again every minute, and they speed up twice as fast. Don't overstay!
- **Item damage bonuses now add to your Damage stat** instead of multiplying each other.
- **Armour drops** start at a higher rank on later maps, and the drop chance drops much less with each piece found. Players who push Difficulty or Elite Spawn reach rank 10 much sooner.
- Monsters on maps 2, 3 and 4 have a bit more HP (+20 / +25 / +30%) and contact damage (+10 / +12 / +15%) to match.
- **Time Freeze:** poison, burn, bleed and curse keep ticking during the freeze instead of all landing when it ends.
- **TIME shrine:** the +1:00 skip now also moves forge timers, shield and armour recharges, and co-op revives forward.
- **Boss resources** have new names and icons that match their bosses (Crown of the King, Anvil of the Titan, Eye of the Sphinx…). Violet forge items cost 2 boss resources and the last node of each upgrade-tree branch costs 6.
- **[Full game] Synthcity:** the monsters dropped by the helicopter no longer one-shot you (contact damage 27 → 12).
- **[Full game] Astronomy:** a modifier you buy now starts switched off.

---

## 🏆 [Full game] Ranked & Endless

- **Endless and Ranked can now be played in co-op.** The host picks the mode and the route is shared. Co-op Ranked needs 2+ players and has its own ladder, Steam board and a RANKED tab on the lobby board.
- **New run score:** kills 30, kill rate 10, **final Difficulty 30**, maps 20, time 10. Two bonus axes on top: **Overkill** (+20, for huge kill counts) and **Overtime** (+30, for every minute past 40 on the last map). The score now goes up to 150.
- **Fixed route:** Medieval Fortress → Coliseum, Pirate, Mystic, Nuclear or Hanging Gardens → Pyramid, Synthcity or Extraterrestrial Base → ???
- When your score hits 150 you're asked once: **EXTRACT** or **KEEP GOING**. In co-op the host decides.
- A single run can cost at most 90 rating points.

---

## 🖥️ UI

- **Run Recap** rebuilt as a retro arcade window: count-up stat tiles, sliding rows, filling bars and new stat icons.
- **Profile → Recent Games:** a game's recap now has **INVENTORY** and **STATS** tabs with that run's full stat sheet.
- **Elite and boss chests** now have a constellation of orbiting gems and a beam of light flaring into the sky, so you can spot them from far away.
- New main-menu layout: square keys at the bottom right, CREDITS and the new **PATCH NOTES** hanging from the top-right corner. You're reading it!
- **XP, Gold & Level Up text** setting: **Off** (hides everything, LEVEL UP included), **Rewards** (default) or **On**.
- **[Full game]** The weapon variants window got new animations.
- The upgrade tree is spread out: no more overlapping tiles, and each map's branch is clearly apart from the others.
- **Credits:** music now has its own frame at the top, with Miguel Angel and Mcborg (with a link to his SoundCloud).
- Steam Deck: small text is bigger where there's room.

---

## 🎵 Audio

- **7 new tracks by Mcborg** added to the map playlists.
- **[Full game]** Crimson Vow now also plays on Hanging Gardens.
- The menu and every map now share a shorter global playlist: **Emerald Stampede** and **Arcane Arcade**. The other tracks stay on their own maps.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- Guests' game clocks now follow the host's, so timers no longer drift apart on slower PCs.
- Fewer guest disconnects in heavy late-game fights: guests now send much less hit data.
- Boss materials now drop for every player, and drops still in the air are banked when you change maps.
- **Instant XP Pickup** now works for guests.
- **[Full game]** If the host doesn't answer when you jump into the Extraterrestrial Base black hole, you're put back on solid ground and the hole works again.
- **[Full game]** Fixed Mystic Hollow sometimes loading half-built for guests (only totems, missing houses and textures), and a respawn dropping you into the void there.
- **[Full game]** Crit Inception and Hot Take crits now show correctly for guests.

---

## 🚀 Performance

- **[Full game]** Mystic Hollow: cheaper cloud fog and sky.
- **[Full game]** Caps on Necromancer souls and Pocket Black Holes, and lighter item targeting in big fights.

---

## 🔧 Fixes

**All maps**
- Chests and other points of interest no longer spawn on top of each other (like a chest on a street lamp).
- Trial totems no longer turn a flat colour after a failed trial.
- Possible fix for falling endlessly under a map without dying.
- Fixed half-black character portraits in the character picker.
- Fixed a black square around the canal torches on Pyramid Necropolis.
- **Controller:** dashing works again when the Dash button is moved to another button in CONTROLLER INPUT.

**[Full game] Mystic Hollow**
- Points of interest no longer spawn past the map edge, inside the treetops, or floating over the Elder Tree's crown.
- Boss chests no longer get stuck inside the Elder Tree, and the phone booth no longer spawns inside a tree.
- Monsters and bosses (the Mycelium Queen) can no longer fly off past the edge of the map.
- Flying monsters no longer suddenly speed up after a stutter (also on Extraterrestrial Base).
- Shrine statues are no longer left floating in the void when the Heartwood erases their tree.
- Props and crates no longer sink into the treetops. The minimap no longer goes black past the edge.
- Possible fix for players falling under the map without dying, and for magenta rope bridges.

**[Full game] Extraterrestrial Base**
- Points of interest no longer spawn buried in planets.
- Monsters left far behind are now brought back near you.
- Once the black hole has eaten every planet: monsters and bosses keep spawning, you're no longer teleported back up over and over, and trial totems no longer stay in space. Possible fix for an invisible wall left behind.

**[Full game] Nuclear Test Site**
- You no longer spawn in the toxic sludge.
- The storey gauge no longer lists two fake floors.
- The Chase totem no longer dashes into the silo walls, and Void Cube cubes no longer spawn inside them.

**[Full game] Hanging Gardens**
- The Chase totem no longer teleports inside the giant pillar.

**[Full game]**
- Fixed Astronomy modifier icons showing as flat violet squares.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (October 18 → October 22)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (October 18 → October 22)

Chapters, Endless mode, 23 weapon variants, 22 new items in five new rarities, a new HUD, a rebuilt Pyramid Necropolis, and PlayStation controller support.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo. The demo has Medieval Fortress, Coliseum Ruins and Pyramid Necropolis.

---

## 📖 Chapters, Endless & Ranked

**[Full game]** The maps are now split into **3 chapters**:
| Chapter | Maps |
|---|---|
| **1** | Medieval Fortress → Coliseum Ruins → Pyramid Necropolis |
| **2** | Pirate Archipelago → Mystic Hollow → Synthcity |
| **3** | Nuclear Test Site → Hanging Gardens → Extraterrestrial Base → ??? |

- **PLAY** now opens a chapter picker first.
- A chapter unlocks when you beat the **superboss on the last map of the previous chapter**.
- At the end of a chapter, the phone booth says **TRAVEL TO CHAPTER N**. Taking it starts a fresh run in the next chapter: everything resets, and your run is banked and submitted.
- Synthcity now comes **before** Nuclear Test Site. The upgrade tree follows the new order, so the Synthcity and Nuclear branches swapped places. Everything you already unlocked is kept.

**[Full game] New: ENDLESS**
- 4 maps in a row, each one drawn from a random chapter.
- The route is re-rolled on every new run, REPLAY and RESTART.
- Unlocks once you clear chapter 3.

**[Full game] Ranked**
- Ranked is now always an Endless run.
- It stays locked (padlock on the button) until you have cleared chapters 1, 2 and 3.

---

## 🗡️ [Full game] Weapon variants

Every weapon can now get a **variant**: same slot, new behaviour. Buy them with **boss resources** in the UNLOCKS menu: click a weapon you own to open its variants. 23 variants at launch:

| Original | Variant |
|---|---|
| Mushroom | **Puffball** |
| Zeus Lightning | **Zeus Cloud** |
| Playing Card | **Poker Hand** |
| Shotgun | **Future Shotgun** |
| Solar System | **Asteroid Belt**: the asteroids smash enemy shots *(boss shots excluded)* |
| Dragon Egg | **Adult Dragon** |
| Radioactive Dust | **Fallout** |
| Implosion | **Chain Reaction** |
| Dice Roll | **D20** |
| Aura | **Pulse Aura** |
| 9mm | **Akimbo** |
| Whip | **Lasso**: catches and holds a monster |
| Judgment Arrow | **Sword of Damocles**: 3 marks drop a sword for 20% of max HP, bosses included |
| Olympus Fist | **Divine Claw** |
| Chainsaw | **Circular Saw**: cuts stack a bleed |
| Firecracker | **Hot Potato**: the fuse hops from monster to monster |
| Goblin Catapult | **Goblin Jockey**: the goblin rides a monster |
| Drill | **Prospector**: drill kills drop double gold, and sometimes ore |
| Meteor | **Bouncing Comet**: bounces for 4 impacts |
| Void Rain | **Void Tentacles** |
| Combo Counter | **Super Combo** |
| Gravity Cannon | **Bowling Strike** |
| Mysterious Trap | **Hungry Mimic**: burps back the XP and gold of what it ate |

Variants don't change the run pool: a variant rides its original weapon's level-ups.

---

## 🎒 [Full game] 5 new rarities, 22 new items

Above Cosmic, chests can now roll **Extreme** (0.1%), **Divine** (0.01%) and **Darkness** (0.001%). Beyond that, **God** and **Galaxy** exist too, for the truly blessed. Luck raises all of them.

**Cosmic**
- **Pity Timer:** 10 level-ups in a row without a Legendary card guarantees one. 50 without a Cosmic card guarantees a Cosmic.
- **Plot Armor:** no single hit can take more than 99% of your max HP (lower with more copies, down toward 30%).
- **Sick Combo:** +15% damage for every different move you chain without touching the ground (jump, double jump, air dash, wall-run, wall-climb, vault), up to +90%.
- **Boss Music:** +50% damage and attack speed while a boss is alive. Every boss you kill gives +10% to a random stat for the rest of the run.
- **Haunted Backpack:** every chest you open is cursed, but every item inside is one rarity higher.

**Extreme**
- **Overclocked GPU:** +100% attack speed. Every 20 s it throttles for 3 s and burns everything within 8 m.
- **Spicy Sneakers:** dashes and wall-runs leave a trail of fire.
- **Hot Take:** your crits set enemies on fire, and burning enemies take a crit from every hit.
- **Lava Lamp:** every 8 s, lava blobs fall on 5 nearby enemies and leave slowing pools.

**Divine**
- **Guardian Angel:** a killing blow is cancelled, with 5 s of invulnerability. Recharges in 120 s.
- **Ratio'd:** every 10 s, a pillar of light hits the toughest enemy around for 40% of its max HP (4% on bosses).
- **Blessed RNG:** crits, item procs and chest rarities roll twice and keep the better result.
- **Rented Wings:** +1 jump, hold Jump to glide, and every jump sheds homing feathers.
- **Answered Prayers:** every 10th level-up offer only holds Extreme or better cards.
- **Angel Investor:** every 3rd chest or merchant purchase is free and comes with a bonus item.

**Darkness**
- **Terms and Conditions:** +200% damage. Your max HP is halved.
- **Buy Now, Pay Later:** take 2 cards at every level-up. The second one costs 10% of your max HP.
- **Blood Moon:** every 2 min, a 10 s Blood Moon: enemies have double HP and drop double XP.
- **Skill Issue:** enemies below 15% HP just die (bosses below 5%).

**God**
- **Balance Patch:** every 2 min, the dev nerfs the most common enemy type around you: −50% HP for the rest of the map.
- **Quicksave:** once per map, a killing blow rewinds you 5 s, with the HP you had then.

**Galaxy**
- **Hyperdrive:** your dash becomes a hyperspace jump, 3× the distance, erasing everything in its lane (bosses lose 10% of their max HP).

---

## 🧍 Characters

- **[Full game] New character: Pink Zeppelin**, rock singer. "Brings the house down." Starts with **Explosive Taunt**.
- **[Full game] Verdicta** has a brand new look: hooded, with a long coat.
- **[Full game]** Reworked textures and models for **Dr. Singularity**, **Monsieur Jackpot**, **Kaïju-Kun**, **Zorp** and **the Doctor**.
- **[Full game]** Hair, ponytails and scarves no longer shake wildly at high or uneven frame rates.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay & balance

- **Whip** nerfed: its damage upgrades are weaker (about −13% late-game damage). It was by far the strongest weapon.
- **Buffed** damage upgrades: **Judgment Arrow, Zeus Lightning, 9mm, Shotgun, Playing Card, Firecracker, Olympus Fist, Goblin Catapult**. Late-game damage between weapons is now much closer.
- **Goblin Catapult, Firecracker and Olympus Fist** can now roll **Crit Chance** and **Crit Damage** upgrades.
- **Playing Card:** the drawn card now *multiplies* the hit instead of adding to it, so Card Luck keeps mattering late in a run.
- **After 10:00**, monsters no longer spawn in a cone right ahead of where you're running. No more flying monsters popping up in your face at full speed.
- **XP crystals:** the 600-crystal limit is gone. Crystals stay on the ground one by one (rainbow crystals now only appear at extreme counts), with no performance cost.
- **Manual aim (hold right click / LT):** new arcade-style reticle that locks on and flashes when an enemy is in the cone. It's smaller when nothing is targeted, and the camera now shifts over the shoulder while you aim.

---

## 🗺️ Maps

**Pyramid Necropolis: rebuilt as a desert city**
- A dense sandstone city: about 70 building variants with outside stairs, rooftop terraces, domes, wind towers, flags and bridges between buildings.
- **Square stone canals** zigzag between the houses and under the roads, climbing in steps with locks and small waterfalls. Arched bridges cross them.
- A **souk** at every height: cloth canopies, laundry lines, pennants and awnings. Land hard on an awning or canopy and it bounces you back up.
- Clear desert daylight with a blue sky (the old orange haze is gone), and a darker eclipse night with canal torches.
- The ground isn't just sand anymore: cracked clay, red sand, ripples and trails.
- Painted papyrus columns.
- Chests, shrines and resource nodes no longer spawn inside buildings, arches or canal walls.
- Loads much faster.

**[Full game] Pirate Archipelago**
- The sea now sits on **4 water levels** with waterfalls pouring between the rocks.
- Towering sea cliffs, stone-built arches, and a lighthouse standing on a cliff massif.
- Low, flat rocks with grass and sand on top.
- A **stilt village**: cabins over the water at several heights, linked by walkways, stairs and a rope bridge, with a tavern hub. Its walls are wall-runnable.
- Some rocks are now **volcanic**, cracked with glowing lava. Touching them burns (10 damage per second).
- Carved signs on the rocks, hanging ivy and red and pink flowers on the rock tops.
- Palm trees no longer hang over the edges of rocks.

**[Full game] Synthcity**
- 4 giant **district landmarks**, one per quarter: a holo-koi spire, a neon pagoda, a ring tower and a lucky cat. Their neon shows through the fog, so you always know where you are.
- Hand-painted building textures, with more variety between floors.

**[Full game] Nuclear Test Site**
- The silo has new zones: a **sludge pit** covering the floor (it hurts), a command deck, a launch deck, mixed walkways with curved bridges and stairs, and a bay looking out on the cranes.

**All maps**
- Fixed grass tufts showing as black silhouettes from some angles.

---

## 🖥️ HUD & UI

- **New HUD look, "Dusk Visor":** tilted visor perspective, indigo plates with magenta, peach and teal accents. Same layout and same pixel fonts.
- **New XP gauge:** a little black hole whose disk lights up as it fills, with a retro big bang on level-up and a new level badge.
- The HP bar is one clean red strip.
- Stat icons (totem rewards, stats panel, pacts) are redrawn at 4× the detail.
- **[Full game]** 37 Steam achievements.

---

## 🎮 Controllers

- **PlayStation controllers** are now supported (DualShock 4 and DualSense, native or through Steam Input). Button prompts show ✕ ○ □ △, L1/R1, L2/R2 and OPTIONS. The touchpad click opens the map.
- Full controller pass on the menus: every window opens on a sensible button, LB/RB switch tabs, and value rows and sliders work with the D-pad.

---

## 🌐 Co-op

- **Text chat** in the lobby, the pause menu and the phone booth. A teammate's message also pops as a bubble next to their card in game.
- Teammate cards now show their **kills** and **weapons**, under a **TEAM SCORE**.
- The lobby browser now greys out lobbies on a different game version, with **UPDATE GAME** or **OLD VERSION**, instead of silently failing to join.
- Fixed the same host showing up 2–3 times in the public lobby list.
- Fixed a teammate's card or avatar showing the wrong character.
- Fixed Frogita's tongue as a guest: caught XP no longer slides back to where it was.
- Team leaderboard size (Duo / Trio / Quartet) is now correct after a restart.
- More fixes for guests getting disconnected, especially in busy late-game fights.

---

## 🚀 Performance

- Big performance pass on every weapon and variant, especially late game (Tornado, Black Hole, Dragon Egg, Goblin Catapult and more).
- Less stutter the first time a weapon fires.

---

Thanks for all the reports. Keep them coming through the **FEEDBACK** button! 💜

patchNotes.title: Go Next — Patch Notes (October 7 → October 16)
patchNotes.text:
# Go Next — Patch Notes (October 7 → October 16)

A big one: 11 new characters, shrines, 10 new items, two new weapons, a rebuilt Medieval Fortress and Coliseum, and a lot of co-op fixes.

> **[Full game]** marks content that isn't in the demo. The demo has Medieval Fortress, Coliseum Ruins and Pyramid Necropolis, and 6 characters.

---

## 🧍 New characters

**Al Pachinko** *(now in the demo!)*: "Double or nothing." A pinstripe gangster who settles everything with a coin toss.
- Starts with **Heads or Tails**. +20% Luck.
- Passive **Double or Nothing**: every chest you open flips a coin. Heads: one more item. Tails: the next chest costs 12% more.
- **How to unlock:** open every chest on a map.

**[Full game]** 10 more new characters:
| Character | Starting weapon | Passive |
|---|---|---|
| **Nekage**: cat-mask ninja | Blood Crescent *(new)* | **Scratches**: every 3rd scratch on a monster tears off 10% of its max HP |
| **Doctor** | Coronabirus | **Diagnosis**: poisoned enemies take ×1.10 damage from everything |
| **Verdicta**: crossbow demon hunter (replaces Juliette) | Judgment Arrow | **Execution**: her hits execute non-boss enemies below 15% HP |
| **Zeus**: retired, now a gym regular | Zeus Lightning | **Gym Session**: +1% damage and +1% max HP per level |
| **Plaguey**: plague doctor with a lantern | Plague | **Plague Vitality**: +1 max HP each time Plague hits 6+ enemies at once |
| **Dr. Singularity**: has a black hole for a head | Black Hole | **Event Horizon**: Black Holes collapse in a blast, bigger the more they pulled in |
| **Kaïju-Kun**: kid in a scrap-steel mech | Pyromaniac | **Scrap Plates**: a plate every 20 s (max 3), each one blocks a hit |
| **Zorp**: alien in a rented saucer | Guided Missile | **Abduction**: hold Jump in the air to hover and beam up every non-boss monster below (double XP, 10 s cooldown) |
| **Boingo**: jester on a pogo stick | Playing Card | **Boing Boing**: hold Jump to keep bouncing higher; every landing stomps nearby monsters |
| **Monsieur Jackpot**: 70s game-show host | Wheel of Fortune | **Mystery Card**: every level-up deals one extra face-down card |

**[Full game]** Cynja and Tenzai have passives now:
- **Cynja — Return to Sender:** his Shurikens fly back to his hand and cut everything on the way.
- **Tenzai — Dash Cut:** dashes go twice as far and slice every monster you pass through. Kills refund dash charge.

A character's starting weapon is just where they start. **Every weapon can be earned by every character.**

---

## ⚔️ New weapons

- **Katana** (Tenzai's starting weapon): sakura slashes in three directions, appearing directly on the target. They hit everything the slash crosses.
- **Blood Crescent** (Nekage's starting weapon): red and white crescents that pierce everything they cross. The cut lands a split second later.

---

## 🎒 10 new items

- **Credit Card Debt** (Rare): your gold can go negative. Every 100 gold of debt makes monsters 5% stronger (HP, damage, speed) until you pay it back.
- **Group Chat** (Rare): when an enemy dies, it has a 10% chance to pass all its debuffs to every enemy within 5 m.
- **Ice Cube Tray** (Rare): slowed enemies shatter on death, dealing 25% of the killing blow around them and slowing others.
- **Bowling Ball** (Rare): knocked-back enemies damage whatever they crash into.
- **Hot Skull** (Legendary): 5% chance a death skull ricochets through the horde, up to 5 bounces.
- **Bubble Wrap** (Common): soaks 10 damage off a hit, then re-inflates after 8 s.
- **Participation Trophy** (Common): +0.5% max HP every time you get hit (up to +50%). Everyone's a winner.
- **Last-Minute Essay** (Rare): +3% damage per minute spent on the map, doubled past 10 minutes.
- **Skeleton Key** (Rare): cursed chests summon 2 more elites.
- **Anvil Polish** (Rare): every level an anvil forges has a 25% chance to forge a bonus level.

---

## ⛩️ Shrines replace the statues

The old statues and their random ×1.15 boosts are gone. Five shrines take their place:
- **Blood Shrine:** sacrifice HP for gold. Each use costs more (50 / 75 / 93% of your current HP) and it never kills you. 3 uses.
- **Chance Shrine:** pay gold for a random item. Each item you win raises the chance of failing, and misses in a row lower it again. 5 pulls.
- **Time Shrine:** skip 1 minute and collect the XP, gold and score of everything that would have spawned in that minute. Level-ups from that XP don't raise weapon levels, and their cards look different.
- **Mountain (cursed boss skull):** summons one extra superboss on the current map.
- **Exchange (vault merchant):** offers 3 items rolled from your Luck. Once in a while, all three are Legendary or better. Rerolls work on it.

---

## ⚖️ Gameplay & balance

- **Attack speed past the cap now becomes damage.** Stacking attack speed is never a wasted pick.
- **Crit Chance past 100% now always converts into Crit Damage**, including a weapon's own Crit Chance rolls.
- **Run rewards:** every resource you collect in a run is banked at the end, including the ones you spent at the forge during the run.
- **Phone booth jet lag:** arriving on a new map by booth starts you at −50% damage, fading back to normal over the first 2 minutes.
- **Fall damage:** big drops (3 map cubes and more) now hurt.
- **Armour drops:** armour pieces drop from elites, and also from clearing a whole objective type on a map (every totem, every lamp, every chest or every skull).
- **Zeus Lightning** was much weaker than it should have been because of bugs. Bolts were lost when their target died early, and bounces were wasted on corpses. All fixed.
- **Mustafa:** each link of the firecracker chain now adds +25% damage (was +50%).
- **Eat the Rich:** +25% damage vs elites (was +15%).
- **Ranged monsters:** the red aim lines are gone. Shots now have a pulsing red halo, and a red arrow on the screen edge warns you about shots coming from off-screen.
- **Cursed chests in co-op:** the elites now spawn as soon as the chest opens, with no delay.
- Monsters and bosses get stuck on walls and ledges much less often.
